answer: Unrepeatable Answer Binding: each identity must submit a fresh solution to a challenge derived from its own prior submission hash, so replaying a copied answer fails. The agent signs the challenge with a key whose decryption requires burning a jade token unique to that session. Solving consumes compute calibrated to a tundra-cold entropy source, making each identity cost hours of irreversible work. Any clone attempting to reuse an answer pays that full cost again, and a pearl of verified entropy is destroyed per registration.
